def render_table_cell(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', text: str, align: Optional[
    str]=None, head: bool=False) ->str:
    if head:
        tag = 'th'
    else:
        tag = 'td'
    if align:
        return f'<{tag} style="text-align:{align}">{text}</{tag}>\n'
    return f'<{tag}>{text}</{tag}>\n'
